components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action style for product and marketing CTAs.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #52796f; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; transition: transform 200ms ease-out, background-color 200ms ease-out, box-shadow 200ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #354f52; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px -2px rgb(82 121 111 / 0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(82 121 111 / 0.35); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Default Card
components.description: Standard content surface for dashboard panels and review modules.
components.html:
Review activity

Recent customer feedback and pending actions.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid #d9ded4; border-radius: 12px; background: #ffffff; color: #2f3e46; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); font-family: 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 6px; color: #2f3e46; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.4; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: #52796f; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Default Input
components.description: Text field style for forms, filters, and customer-facing inputs.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #354f52; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-field input { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid #d9ded4; border-radius: 8px; background: #f7f8f5; color: #2f3e46; padding: 10px 16px; font: inherit; font-weight: 400; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #52796f; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(82 121 111 / 0.20); }

narrative.overview: RepWell is a calm operating surface for reputation work: precise enough for managers, warm enough for customer-facing professionals, and polished enough to support public trust. The system uses restrained teal and sage, white and softly tinted surfaces, and a serif display voice only when it adds credibility or editorial warmth.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained teal and sage palette with deep teal text.
Erstoria for brand presence and Source Sans 3 for product UI.
White cards, light sage-tinted backgrounds, visible borders, and small radius.

rules.name: The Teal Does Work Rule
rules.body: Teal is for primary action, active state, links, charts, and meaningful emphasis.

rules.name: The Serif Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Use Erstoria for trust and brand presence, not for controls or dense data.

rules.name: The Flat Until Touched Rule
rules.body: Surfaces should not look floaty at rest; elevation appears in response to interaction.

dos: Do use the existing teal and sage tokens for brand vocabulary.
Do show workflow state for reviews, videos, approvals, publishing, and follow-ups.
Do keep product transitions short and stateful.
donts: Don't use cluttered dashboards, aggressive CTAs, sterile corporate SaaS, or overly playful startup styling.
Don't use purple gradients, neon AI tooling, glassmorphism, decorative motion, or gradient text.
Don't use generic gray panels when a teal or sage tinted neutral already exists.
